# Routledge

> Routledge is a leading academic and professional publisher offering books, textbooks, and ebooks across STEM, humanities, and social sciences with a catalog spanning 185+ years of publishing excellence.

Routledge & CRC Press publishes peer-reviewed research, academic textbooks, and professional books for students, instructors, and researchers worldwide. The publisher operates as part of Taylor & Francis Group and offers curated collections, book series, and digital resources alongside traditional print offerings.

## Browse & Discover Books

- [Subjects - Books in STEM, Humanities, and Social Sciences](https://www.routledge.com/subjects): Subject directory for browsing books in STEM, humanities, social sciences
- [New and Bestselling Titles](https://www.routledge.com/new-and-bestselling-books): New releases and bestselling books across all subject categories
- [Featured Books - Book Lists](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists): Curated book lists and featured collections from Routledge Classics and other series
- [Routledge Classics - Celebrating 25 Years](https://www.routledge.com/book-lists/routledge-classics): Routledge Classics book series collection celebrating 25th anniversary
- [Routledge Companions - Book Series](https://www.routledge.com/Routledge-Companions/book-series/ROUTCOMPS): Routledge Companions academic book series for research and reference

## For Authors & Instructors

- [Publish With Us](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/authors): Author publishing guide covering book proposals, process, and services
- [Request An Inspection Copy](https://www.routledge.com/our-customers/instructors/textbooks/inspection-copies): Guide for instructors to request inspection/exam copies for course adoption
